name: @frillab/copc-adapter
description: Stream and visualize COPC point clouds directly in CesiumJS and Three.js.

scripts.build: tsc && npm run prepare-assets && vite build
scripts.build:ci: tsc && npm run prepare-laz-perf && vite build
scripts.build:library: npm run clean:library && npm run prepare-library-assets && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && npm run finalize-library-assets
scripts.build:library:ci: npm run clean:library && cp node_modules/laz-perf/lib/web/laz-perf.wasm src/wasm/laz-perf.wasm && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && npm run finalize-library-assets
scripts.test: npm run prepare-copc-wasm && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:conformance:unit: npm run prepare-copc-wasm && CONFORMANCE_SKIP_INTEGRATION=1 node --import tsx --test test/backend-conformance.test.mjs
scripts.test:conformance:integration: npm run prepare-copc-wasm && node --import tsx --test test/backend-conformance.test.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run prepare-copc-wasm && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage test/*.test.mjs
scripts.prepare-assets: npm run prepare-copc-wasm && npm run prepare-laz-perf
